method: Official operator page opened with the agent's page-fetch tool, or the official page's own text returned in a web-search index. Every claim below carries a verbatim quote. Nothing is inferred, converted between currencies, or filled in from memory.

evidence_kinds.official-page: The operator's own page was opened and the quoted text was read directly.
evidence_kinds.official-page-index: The operator's own page text was returned through a search index; the URL is the operator's.
evidence_kinds.secondary-official-terms: A third-party page quoting the operator's published terms was read; the operator page was not opened. Treated as weaker evidence.

status_legend.verified: Every field in `fields` was read on the cited page and matches the catalogue.
status_legend.partially-verified: Some fields confirmed, at least one material field (usually free entry) is not stated on the page read.
status_legend.contradicted: At least one catalogue field is contradicted by the cited official page. The specific contradicted fields are listed in `contradicted_fields`; other fields on the row may still be verified and keep their own quotes.
status_legend.not-verified: Nothing was read this pass; the row keeps only its operator link.
